title: Peer interviewer storybook
intro: Nine moments in a live interview with PEER_INTERVIEWER_ENABLED on. Each step shows the Copilot panel the interviewer sees and, next to it, every call made behind it: the websocket message, the graph node, the model call. The candidate never sees any of this.
rolloutTitle: Flag off first, then one session at a time
rolloutLede: Everything ships dark. The order below is the order to turn it on in.
